item.title: 使用jq格式化剪贴板上的JSON
item.description:

item.description:
📝 While feature flag management software can be powerful, they are also a source of complexity and risk. We’ve convinced ourselves that we don’t just need a few feature flags, we need to scale to thousands of feature flags. Hardcoded feature flags do away with many of these issues; they are simple, reliable, and safe.
